conventions.numbers: inputs are decimal STRINGS with at most two decimals and are read exactly (never through a float); exact values are written "p/q" or "p"
conventions.statement: a1*x + b1 REL a2*x + b2 with REL one of = < ≤ > ≥
conventions.set: none | all | {point, x} | {ray, side: below|above, bound, closed}; 'below' means every x under the bound
conventions.operations: add: both sides + value; add-x: both sides + value*x; scale: both sides * value; divide: both sides / value; scale/divide by 0 are rejected
conventions.reversal: an inequality's relation reverses exactly when the factor is negative; 'forced: false' marks a degenerate statement whose truth table cannot tell the two apart
conventions.extraneous: sqrt(x + p) = x + q; D = 4p - 4q + 1; roots x = u + v*sqrt(b) with b square-free (b = 1: rational); status valid when +sqrt(x + p) = x + q
conventions.pathFinal: the statement after the derived solution path (subtract a2*x, subtract b1, divide by a1 - a2 unless that is 0 or 1)

tolerance.unit: absolute, on the decimal approximation of an irrational root
tolerance.rationale: the TypeScript evaluates u + v*sqrt(b) in doubles (|value| <= ~12); the oracle evaluates the same root to 60 digits and rounds once. Exact values, signs, relations, sets, classifications and counts must match EXACTLY.
